visual_action: The video opens with a clip of Donald Trump speaking at a rally from behind a podium. It then transitions to a montage of clips from an American ice hockey team's game. The montage includes the team lined up on the ice with a large American flag projected onto it, close-ups of players, and various action shots of skating, scoring goals, and physical checks. There is also a shot of an excited fan in the stands wearing an Uncle Sam-style hat and waving a small American flag. The video concludes with a black screen displaying the text "THE WHITE HOUSE" with an icon of the building.

spoken_summary: The video begins with audio of a Donald Trump speech where he says, "We're going to win so much, you may even get tired of winning... and you'll say, please, please, it's too much winning... And I'll say, no, it isn't. We have to keep winning. We have to win more." The audio then transitions to a dramatic choir singing what sounds like a version of Madonna's "Like a Prayer" over the sports montage.

After his speech clip ends, there is a whoosh sound effect, and the audio transitions to a powerful, dramatic choral song identified as "Like a Prayer (Choir Version From ‘Deadpool & Wolverine’)". This epic music plays over the hockey montage, creating a heroic and triumphant atmosphere.

intended_effect: To create a powerful feeling of American pride and triumph by associating the White House with the success of Team USA, and to generate excitement for their upcoming Olympic game.
